items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Well, I heard talk about Ann Cook. Well, I don't know that Ann Cook used to sell.

ctx.x: He's from over the river, they say, but he's up north now. He with them. Yeah, I went to all of them when they came here, man. Caught me four and a half to see Louis Armstrong, and four and a nine, eight, twice. I ain't gonna pay no more. Yeah, they was at the auditorium, Louis Armstrong, I see, Lionel Hampton. It was a packed house, but I tell you, they went there most for that little son to come there, but his son didn't shoot up, Lionel Hampton. I seen Night King Cole.
Well, I just forgot to ask, I started to ask, did you ever know Ann Cook uptown?

Well, I heard talk about Ann Cook. Well, I don't know that Ann Cook used to sell. That Ann Cook used to sing and she used to sell macho, you know, mean fools around in boats on the river. Maybe. Ann Cook. Yeah, she used to stay uptown around Grabby or Padilla Street. She used to stay.
